caption: The drawing features two similarly sized, slightly conical objects depicted against a plain, neutral background. The objects are rendered in shades of beige and light brown, suggesting an organic material with a smooth texture. The left object is shown at an angle, exposing its curved surface that features an engraved or etched illustration; the illustration depicts two human figures with detailed costumes and some foliage or background elements. The object to the right is oriented horizontally with its open end facing the viewer, revealing a hollow interior and the subtle texture of the outer surface, which also appears to have engraved patterns, though less clearly visible than those on the left object.
